items.title: Add progress percentage and animation to pre-boot loading bar
items.what: On the ShoeMoney pre-boot loading screen (390x844 portrait), the thin brown horizontal progress bar (positioned 70% from the top) lacks a percentage label and animated fill, remaining a static thin line
items.why: Players cannot assess download completion time, increasing the likelihood of abandoning the game before it launches
items.how: Overlay a centered white 14px percentage text label on the progress bar and animate the bar’s fill from left to right with each download increment (e.g., 1% fill per 1% download completion)

items.title: Visualize inactive control sticks on fight start screens
items.what: On qualifier fight start screens (e.g., the screen with "STARTING IN 2" text), the left (STANCE) and right (TECHNIQUE) control sticks (bottom 20% of the frame) have identical gray arrow and dot styling to active sticks, with no opacity or color change to indicate inactivity
items.why: Players attempt to input controls prematurely, leading to confusion about game responsiveness and potential frustration
items.how: Reduce the control sticks’ opacity to 30% and desaturate the arrow and dot colors to 50% saturation until the "STARTING IN" timer reaches 0, then restore full opacity and saturation

items.title: Hide control sticks on post-fight result screens
items.what: On the Hasanabi wins post-fight screen, the left (STANCE) and right (TECHNIQUE) control sticks (bottom 20% of the frame) remain visible but inactive, cluttering the area around the "REMATCH" button
items.why: Unnecessary UI elements distract players from core post-fight actions (e.g., initiating a rematch), slowing gameplay flow
items.how: Set the display property of the control sticks to none when the post-fight result overlay (e.g., "HASANABI WINS") is active

items.title: Add selected move highlight to Techniques menu
items.what: On the Techniques menu screen, none of the move entries (e.g., "Lunge Punch") have a visual highlight (e.g., border, background color) to indicate which move is currently selected or referenced in the fight screen
items.why: Players cannot quickly identify their focused move, increasing the time spent planning strategies and reducing gameplay pace
items.how: Add a 2-pixel gold border around the selected move entry and increase the entry’s text opacity to 100% (from 80% for unselected entries)

items.title: Enhance readability of Left-handed layout toggle description
items.what: On the Settings menu screen, the descriptive text for the "Left-handed layout" toggle ("Swaps which side the stance and technique sticks sit on.") is 12px, low-contrast gray, and positioned 5px below the toggle label, making it hard to read on portrait phones
items.why: Players miss critical information about control layout customization, leading to suboptimal control setup and reduced gameplay performance
items.how: Increase the text size to 14px, change the color to warm tan (matching HUD accents), and align the text 2px below the toggle label for clear visual association
